layout_architecture.dashboard_mode: MODE B: High Density Command Center (3-Column Layout)
layout_architecture.spacing_philosophy: Tactical dense spacing (gap-5, p-5 to p-6) with crisp 1px borders, avoiding fluffy bloated margins.
layout_architecture.border_radius: rounded-lg or rounded-md (max 8px) to preserve military/tactical precision

procedural_svg_progress_rings.concept: Mathematical circular HUD rings with stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset transitions, neon cyan glow filter, and tick marks around 360 degrees.
procedural_svg_progress_rings.implementation: SVG with r=42, circumference=263.89, gradient stroke from #00f3ff to #38bdf8, feDropShadow or drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,243,255,0.4)].

visual_enhancers.tactical_scanline_overlay: Optional subtle background radial glow with 1px isometric grid pattern (rgba(0,243,255,0.03)) to simulate an athletic HUD monitor.
visual_enhancers.human_demo_components: Looping SVG vector athlete rigging and frame-by-frame exercise demo animations rather than heavy 3D canvases, keeping performance at 60 FPS on student hostel laptops.

ai_camera_coach_spec.privacy_first_guarantee: 100% Client-side execution in WebGL/WASM. Zero video frames sent across network.

squat.rep_trigger: DOWN -> UP transition with complete depth

form_cues.too_shallow: Chest up! Sink lower to parallel (<95°)

pushup.rep_trigger: INFLECTION at bottom -> full lockout at top

form_cues.sagging_hips: Brace core; avoid arched lower back

visibility_gating.warning_ui: HUD message 'Step back: full body keypoints not visible' with glowing amber warning badge

Current Rep Counter in massive Cyber-Cyan font
Real-time Form Feedback Banner (Instant Audio/Chime beep & Neon Flash)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, selectors, tabs, inputs, camera triggers, and count displays MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-camera-button', data-testid='rep-counter-display', data-testid='exercise-select-squat', data-testid='low-impact-toggle', data-testid='save-workout-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.zero_transparent_containers: Every header, modal, card, dropdown, and HUD overlay MUST use solid or saturated dark glass backgrounds (e.g., bg-[#121212]/95 backdrop-blur-md with border border-white/10). No raw transparent containers over moving video or feeds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.state_persistence: Workout history, rep logs, personal records, and user questionnaire settings MUST persist safely to browser localStorage under 'bits_in_motion_data' with automatic fallbacks for mock initial state.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.pure_client_side: No backend dependency. Camera inference runs strictly client-side via Web Workers / MediaPipe Pose Landmarker or lightweight mock simulation fallback if webcam permission is denied or device camera is unavailable.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.sound_and_haptics: Provide optional Web Audio API synthetic beeps (high beep on valid rep count, soft click on phase change) with a mute toggle in the Command Center top bar.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Rep Target Reached!', 'Workout Logged to LocalStorage', 'Camera Form Gating Active').
